brief: A seed-starting tray of at least four cells, each with a draining bin.

requirements.requirement: Each cell with a draining bin
requirements.evidence: 4x hex-bin-full-drain bins installed, one per cell, each with drainage holes
Bins filled with soil and planted with seedlings (basil, lettuce, tomato, parsley) demonstrating use

finish.summary: Built 4-cell cluster with drained bins in each cell, soil-filled and planted to show seed-starting use.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
